assets.what: Majaz al-Qur'an of Abu Ubayda (d. 209), the only Quran-specialized philology text present: 1,308 entries keyed by Quranic phrase and ayah marker (1,287 distinct markers). assets.coverage: Majaz: phrase-level glosses for about 1,300 Quranic loci across the Quran (my count of distinct markers). Asas: root-keyed. Sibawayh/poetry: audit corpora.
assets.unharvested_potential: NEW. Never used (grep 0 hits). Majaz gives per-ayah early gloss evidence (NS10 source for a reading). Asas separates literal from figurative extensions of a root, which is exactly the move from a concrete branch to an ayah's latent image (NS7). Poetry attests register and collocation.
assets.quality: Manifest reliability notes: Majaz 'strongest as verse/form/construction evidence, not as root-dictionary evidence'; Asas 'strong for metaphor, collocation, figurative extension'. Segmentation is by regex (manifest section_regex), so entry boundaries may be imperfect.

pretraining_gap_signals: Recorded (quran-slm inter-ayah outputs, my counts): retrieval top-100 candidates graded 16.7% strong and 22.6% no value. The same agent's memory-only follow-up added 299,667 passages (median 43 per ayah), 48.1% strong and 48.1% medium, with only 68 overlapping retrieval. Inference: for QeQ-style parallels the model's pretraining recall is large and mostly disjoint from the retriever. QeQ need not be pushed as bulk data (NS6, NS13), but memory references need a verification step.

Recorded (sample of 800 focus ayat, strong/medium rows, excluding 13 roots in more than 400 ayat): memory suggestions share no content root with the focus in 56% of cases (20,326 of 36,300) vs 26% for retrieved (10,019 of 37,985). Memory suggestions are 92.5% other-surah vs 78% for retrieved. Inference: pretraining supplies thematic cross-surah parallels; retrieval supplies lexical and same-surah ones.

Recorded (my script): of 11,637 Quranic dictionary branches, 4,840 (42%) were never activated in HFT (90 surahs) or v12 cross-run anchors. 4,243 of those belong to roots where another branch was activated. The never-activated rate falls with root frequency: 64% for roots with 0-1 words, 48% for 2-10, 27% for 11-100, 13% for more than 100. Adding the channel reviews, 4,271 branches (37%) were never touched. Inference: minor branches of rare roots are where model recall ends and the dictionary must supply. Confound: HFT packets were 'lean', so some branches may never have been offered.

Recorded (quran-roots MODEL-BEHAVIOR-FINDINGS.md F7): gold findings whose carriers share no Arabic token (texture axis, vertical axis, water field) were produced only under free scene lenses and vanished when discovery was steered by token-match tables or embeddings. 'Any GPT pipeline steered by retrieval/matching artifacts inherits the artifact's blindness.'

Recorded (quran-roots LESSONS.md): the concrete/rural branch class (animals, roads, water, lodgings) is the systematic blind spot of every pipeline pass. 'Model memory is never evidence'; injected inventory 're-weights the model away from its training priors'; 'richer data raises recall and apophenia pressure together' (v5/METHODOLOGY.md section 1.3).

Recorded (MODEL-BEHAVIOR-FINDINGS.md section 3b): high-effort triage deferrals converted 48/48, while its dismissals were about 85% wrong (30/35 converted at max). This is direct evidence for NS8's ban on early pruning.

Recorded (dictionary S1 audit): excerpt-only screening of 157 branches raised 19 flags, 10 of them false alarms. Luna passed 6 of 9 known-problem branches. Model lexical judgment without full classical text is unreliable in both directions. 11 confirmed definition errors remain unrepaired, so a dictionary sense is not automatically safe either.

Measurable, not yet run: root-etymology.tsv (1,668 roots of CORE/PHYSICAL narratives citing Lane, Lisan and Maqayis from memory) could be diffed against the actual Lisan, Lane and Maqayis texts in quran-roots/_corpus/lexicons/cache to estimate how often memory-cited lexicon claims are wrong.

Measurable, not yet run: the exegete glosses embedded in Lisan (al-Farra' 2,470 mentions, al-Zajjaj 1,091, Abu Ubayda 753), Majaz al-Qur'an (1,308 loci) and Mufradat (8,056 ayah refs) give a per-ayah classical answer key. A cold model could be asked for the classical gloss of an ayah's rare word and scored against it, measuring which senses need data (Q2a).

Recorded (dictionary root packet ض ل ل): the stray-animal sense 'لا يعرف ربها' (a named North Star aha) is attested in the Ayn text and branch B005, and is absent from the Jamhara, Maqayis, Mufradat, Sihah and Tahdhib texts in the packet. Rare aha senses may rest on a single source, so source-count metadata (root_source_coverage in quran_furuq_portable.sqlite) is a cheap rarity signal.

Recorded (quran-roots LESSONS 'water test'): a base-rate check (water field 0.44 in the passage vs 0.40 in the corpus, 'at_base') caught an overclaim. Base-rate nulls (non-Quran replicate batches, mock passages in activation/v15) are available as controls for whether an image is surah-specific.

Recorded (quran-slm s1_ar3_v1_feasibility.md): SLM path search recovered 12 of 26 eligible S1 gold items (46.15% inclusive recall) at 16.7 reviewed paths per recovered item. Distance alone does not reach the gold.
